solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Blaise, perhaps, having way with pen

parts.note: a mode is a way or manner of doing something
a sty is a pen for pigs

explanation.surface: Someone called Blaise seems to have a gift for writing.
explanation.walkthrough: Modesty Blaise is the heroine of a long-running British comic strip and novels, so 'Blaise, perhaps' gives her first name by example.
explanation.definitionFit: The comic-strip adventuress Modesty Blaise carries this first name, so Blaise is one bearer of it.

clue.text: Get on a short distance in a clapped-out Sierra

parts.note: to mount is to get on a horse or bike

indicators.note: clapped-out means worn out and falling apart, so the letters of in a are jumbled

parts.note: a chain is an old unit of length, 22 yards

explanation.surface: Climbing into an old, worn-out Ford Sierra car.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface reads Sierra as a car, but it is the Spanish-derived word for a jagged range of peaks; 'clapped-out' rearranges IN A into AIN.
explanation.definitionFit: A sierra is a long jagged range of peaks, a linked series of summits.

clue.text: Fancy one short speech is using computer technology?

parts.note: to dig something is slang for to like or fancy it
I is the Roman numeral for one

indicators.note: short means the word for speech loses its final letter

parts.note: a talk is a speech

explanation.surface: Someone asks whether a brief speech is fancy because it uses computers.
explanation.definitionFit: Electronic computing works with discrete binary values, so tech of that kind is described this way.

clue.text: Row close to huge wave

parts.note: a spat is a row or quarrel

indicators.note: close to means the final letter of huge is taken

explanation.surface: A boat is rowed near an enormous wave.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Row' looks like a verb about boats but is a noun, a quarrel.
explanation.definitionFit: A sudden flood or rush of things, like a wave of burglaries, is a sudden outpouring.

clue.text: Person shouting to muffle regularly good singer

indicators.note: to muffle is to wrap up, so the word for a shouter wraps round the letters taken from good

parts.note: a yeller is a person who shouts

indicators.note: regularly means every other letter of good is taken

explanation.surface: A shouting man is told to keep a good singer quiet.
explanation.walkthrough: 'regularly' takes the even letters of 'good', and 'to muffle' has the shouter's word wrap round them.
explanation.definitionFit: Alpine warbling that switches between chest voice and falsetto is a style of singing.

clue.text: Occupant of bed regrets you're taking it back

indicators.note: back means the hidden run is read in the reverse direction
the phrase regrets you're takes the letters inside it, so they are hidden there

explanation.surface: Someone sorry for having wronged you is withdrawing what they said.
explanation.walkthrough: 'taking it' picks letters out of 'regrets you're' and 'back' turns them round. 'bed' is a seabed where shellfish are farmed, not a bed for sleeping.
explanation.definitionFit: These shellfish are farmed in beds on the sea floor, so one is a resident of such a bed.

clue.text: Old, old Asian brought up a problem with fluid

indicators.note: in a down clue brought up means the word is read from bottom to top

parts.note: the Medes were an ancient people of Asia, in what is now Iran

explanation.surface: An elderly Asian man brought up a fluid-related health issue.
explanation.walkthrough: 'brought up' reverses MEDE to give EDEM.
explanation.definitionFit: Swelling caused by excess watery liquid collecting in body tissues is the medical condition meant.

clue.text: Boat departs, given access to fuel? It's undecided

parts.note: a sub, submarine, is a boat

indicators.note: given access to means the letter for departs is let inside the word for fuel

parts.note: juice is slang for fuel, petrol or electricity
D is the timetable abbreviation for departs

explanation.surface: Whether a boat may leave once it can reach fuel remains an open question.
explanation.walkthrough: The Latin legal phrase for a case still before a court, so not yet decided.
explanation.definitionFit: A matter still awaiting a judge's ruling has not been settled, so it is unresolved.

clue.text: Building journalist provided rocks

parts.note: ed, editor, is a journalist
if means provided that
rocks is slang for ice, as in a drink on the rocks

explanation.surface: A building where a journalist supplied the gems.
explanation.definitionFit: A large, imposing structure is a grand piece of architecture.

clue.text: Rash, one caused by such a fire?

definitions.text: one caused by such a fire?
definitions.meaning: fire here means sack: a guard who has been fired is made '...', no longer a guard

explanation.surface: A skin rash, one perhaps brought on by sitting too near a fire.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface pictures a skin rash from a fire, but 'Rash' is the adjective meaning reckless and 'fire' means dismiss from a job.
explanation.definitionFit: Speaking without caution or care is rash behaviour; a guard sacked from the post is no longer guarding.

clue.text: Man maybe taking risks, losing races

indicators.note: losing means the letters for races are dropped from the longer word

parts.note: betting is taking risks with money
the TT races are the motorcycle races held on the Isle of Man

explanation.surface: A man from the Isle of Man gambles but loses at the races.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Man' and 'races' together suggest the Isle of Man TT motorcycle races, but 'Man' is mankind and 'races' only supplies TT.
explanation.definitionFit: A man is one example of a living creature or existing thing, hence the 'maybe'.

clue.text: Like good gardener's area for putting on felt

parts.note: on a golf course the green is where players putt
fingered means touched or felt

explanation.surface: A golfer's putting green is felt over by a skilled gardener.
explanation.walkthrough: 'felt' looks like the fabric used on tables but is the past tense of feel.
explanation.definitionFit: A skilled grower has an idiomatic knack with plants, described by this colourful phrase about the hands.

clue.text: It's about the tax

indicators.note: about means the word it is turned round to face the other way

explanation.surface: Someone remarks that the matter concerns tax.
explanation.definitionFit: A tenth of produce or income paid to the church was a traditional levy, so it is a kind of tax.

clue.text: Left one timid person squeezing in vehicle

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one

indicators.note: squeezing means the word for a timid person is wrapped round the word in

parts.note: a mouse is a timid, shy person

explanation.surface: A shy passenger is left squashed inside a car.
explanation.definitionFit: A long, luxurious chauffeur-driven car is a type of vehicle.

clue.text: One large officer, half upset, is unsuitable

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one
L is the clothing-size abbreviation for large
Lt is the abbreviation for lieutenant, an officer

indicators.note: in a down clue upset would mean turned over; here it says the word for half is read backwards

parts.note: demi- is a prefix meaning half

explanation.surface: A single big officer, half upset, behaves inappropriately.
explanation.walkthrough: 'upset' reverses DEMI to give IMED.
explanation.definitionFit: Something done at a bad moment is inappropriate to the occasion, hence unsuitable.

clue.text: Moderate papers holding centre ground finally close

indicators.note: holding means the identity abbreviation keeps the rearranged letters inside it

parts.note: ID papers are identity documents

indicators.note: ground means crushed and broken up, so the letters of centre are rearranged
finally means the last letter of close is taken

explanation.surface: Mediation papers hold a central ground, finally closing a dispute.
explanation.walkthrough: 'ground' is the anagram signal, not a noun for land; 'finally' takes the last letter of 'close'.
explanation.definitionFit: To step in between quarrelling parties is to mediate or moderate between them.

clue.text: Flyer with current data about something resembling egg?

parts.note: I is the symbol for electric current

indicators.note: about means the word for data is placed around the egg-shaped letter

parts.note: gen is British slang for information or data
the letter O is egg-shaped

explanation.surface: A pilot has up-to-date information about an egg-like object.
explanation.definitionFit: This dabbling duck is a bird, and birds are flyers.

clue.text: Ready way around cutting grass

indicators.note: cutting means the letters for way and around slice into the slang word

parts.note: grass and hash are both slang for cannabis
Rd is the abbreviation for road, a way
ca, circa, means around

explanation.surface: A road ready to curve round and cut through the grass.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Ready' is the noun, slang for money as in 'the readies'.
explanation.definitionFit: Readies is British slang for banknotes, so ready money is physical notes and coins.

clue.text: Junior minister to organise exhibitions

definitions.meaning: an assistant priest in a parish is a junior minister of the church
the verb means to select and arrange items for a show or museum

explanation.surface: A junior government minister is put in charge of staging exhibitions.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Junior minister' suggests government, but the minister is a clergyman.
explanation.definitionFit: An assistant parish priest is a junior clergyman; and a gallery organiser arranges shows in the verbal sense.

clue.text: Improve drench that's painful

parts.note: to ret is to soak flax or hemp
ouch is the cry for something painful

explanation.surface: Getting soaked improves something that hurts.
explanation.definitionFit: Touching up a photo or painting enhances it, so it is a way of making better.

clue.text: Train skater in West Indies to take up another sport

indicators.note: in means the rearranged letters sit inside the abbreviation for the islands
to train is to work on and reshape, so the letters of skater are rearranged

explanation.surface: A coach trains an ice skater in the Caribbean to switch to a new sport.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Train' is the anagram signal on 'skater', not a railway train or coaching.
explanation.definitionFit: Skimming behind a motorboat on skis is a further sport one can take up.

clue.text: Keep mum, say, closer

parts.note: sh is the call to keep quiet
to utter is to say

explanation.surface: Be quiet, someone says, sidling nearer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'closer' looks like the comparative of close but is the noun, a thing that closes.
explanation.definitionFit: A hinged window panel shuts out light, so it is a device that closes.

clue.text: Smart police force once occupying small gym

indicators.note: occupying means the old police force's letters move in and fill a space inside the others

parts.note: PE, physical education, is school gym
the RUC, Royal Ulster Constabulary, was Northern Ireland's police force until 2001

explanation.surface: A smartly dressed old police unit takes over a little gymnasium.
explanation.definitionFit: Neat and well turned out in appearance is what smart means of dress.

clue.text: A tick for one old king skipping posh old school

indicators.note: skipping means the letter for posh is left out of the king's name

parts.note: Arthur is the legendary old king of Britain
U stands for upper-class, posh
a pod is a school of whales or dolphins

explanation.surface: A tick marks an old king who skipped attending a posh old school.
explanation.walkthrough: 'skipping' removes U from ARTHUR to give ARTHR.
explanation.definitionFit: Ticks, like insects and spiders, belong to the jointed-legged invertebrate phylum, so a tick is an example.

clue.text: Stuck my job, having abandoned India

indicators.note: having abandoned means the India letter is dropped from the word for the setter's job

parts.note: the setter speaks: writing clues is the setter's job
I is India in the NATO phonetic alphabet

explanation.surface: Someone stuck in their job after giving up a post in India.
explanation.walkthrough: 'my job' is the setter talking about clue-writing.
explanation.definitionFit: To have held fast or adhered to something is to have stuck to it.

clue.text: Bishop visiting killer's shack

indicators.note: visiting means the bishop's letter goes into the killer's name

parts.note: Cain, who slew his brother Abel, is the Bible's first killer
B is the chess abbreviation for bishop

explanation.surface: A bishop calls at the hut of a murderer.
explanation.definitionFit: A small, roughly built hut is a simple dwelling such as a log hut.

clue.text: Pointless showing wit and energy

parts.note: nous is common sense or wit
E is the physics symbol for energy

explanation.surface: It is futile showing off cleverness and vigour.
explanation.definitionFit: Saying something has no purpose or value is calling it pointless, an idiom of futility.

clue.text: Capital raging at New Labour

indicators.note: raging means furious and out of control, so the letters are thrown into disorder

explanation.surface: Someone angry at New Labour, Tony Blair's rebranded Labour Party.
explanation.walkthrough: 'raging' shuffles AT, N and LABOUR together.
explanation.definitionFit: The Mongolian seat of government is a capital city.

clue.text: Appropriate article that is very penetrating

indicators.note: penetrating means the letters for that is and very go inside the article

parts.note: the is the definite article
i.e. is the abbreviation of id est, that is

explanation.surface: A fitting piece of writing that is very insightful.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Appropriate' is the verb meaning take for oneself, not the adjective meaning suitable.
explanation.definitionFit: To appropriate something is to take it without permission, which is stealing.

clue.text: Five score for former county division

definitions.meaning: a score is twenty, so five of them make this number
historically an English county was divided into administrative areas of this name

explanation.surface: A tally of five scores for an old county area.
explanation.definitionFit: Five twenties make the number; and in old England shires were split into these subdivisions, each with its own court.
